_comment: Import into Pterodactyl 1.x. AzuRaya service egg.
name: AzuRaya Inbox
author: azurifydigitalsolutions@gmail.com
description: AzuRaya Inbox portal. Upload the inbox ZIP and .env, then start.
startup: if [ ! -f server.mjs ]; then echo 'server.mjs not found: upload and unarchive the inbox ZIP into /home/container'; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} node server.mjs
